tools.name: ino_get_capabilities
tools.description: Inspect verified/limited/blocked capabilities; do not infer capabilities from method names.

tools.name: ino_list_hosts
tools.description: List registered InoProShop bridge instances, not arbitrary Windows processes.

tools.name: ino_list_projects
tools.description: List registered projects and their explicit host bindings and memory state.

tools.name: ino_open_project
tools.description: Open an isolated project copy on the specified host. Never overwrite a dirty user project.

tools.name: ino_list_project_templates
tools.description: List explicit local templates with pinned bytes, model and expected native controller identity. Missing or changed templates are not ready.

tools.name: ino_create_project
tools.description: Open a new copy of a hash-bound template and verify its native root controller. Failed or unknown verification blocks source writes.

tools.name: ino_capture_snapshot
tools.description: Capture current host-object-model content, including synchronized unsaved source, into an immutable snapshot.

tools.name: ino_read_object
tools.description: Read object tree or paginated ST/GVL source from a fixed snapshot with GUID and source locations.

tools.name: ino_read_configuration
tools.description: Read supported configuration facts from a fixed snapshot; missing fields remain explicitly unknown.

tools.name: ino_export_context
tools.description: Export a fixed snapshot as an AI context package with source and coverage manifests.

tools.name: context_index_snapshot
tools.description: Build and publish a versioned PLC symbol graph for this immutable snapshot.

tools.name: context_search
tools.description: Search the PLC snapshot graph with source evidence, bounded results, and index revision.

tools.name: context_search_text
tools.description: Search available immutable snapshot text literally without any graph backend or host calls. Text matches are not semantic references.

tools.name: context_find_references
tools.description: Find scope-aware references using a stable symbol ID; distinguish uncertain candidate edges.

tools.name: context_get_impact
tools.description: Return a bounded dependency/impact graph with coverage and uncertain relations.

tools.name: ino_preview_change
tools.description: Preview a single ST implementation or declaration/implementation edit preserving POU identity, or a new FB with an explicit caller. Return immutable diffs and exact patch hash without writing source.

tools.name: ino_apply_change
tools.description: Apply an explicitly authorized immutable patch with backup, readback and native compile. Never retry an unknown write outcome.

tools.name: ino_compile
tools.description: Compile the bound active Application and preserve actual scope, completion evidence and original diagnostics.

tools.name: ino_get_diagnostics
tools.description: Read paginated diagnostics tied to their original compilation snapshot; do not treat an empty message list as success.

tools.name: ino_restore_checkpoint
tools.description: Conditionally restore a checkpoint only if the expected current version still matches, then verify recovery.

tools.name: ino_save_copy
tools.description: Persist the expected in-memory version to an allowed project-copy destination and report binding changes.

tools.name: ino_get_operation
tools.description: Poll a durable operation and inspect editing, compilation, saving and index statuses separately. Explicit reconcile=true reconciles an unknown save outcome with read-only evidence; it never replays the native write.

tools.name: ino_cancel_operation
tools.description: Request cancellation; this cannot interrupt an in-flight proprietary host API call.

tools.name: ino_set_monitor
tools.description: Enable/disable bounded change monitoring. Automatic compile is opt-in; monitoring never changes or saves source.

tools.name: ino_get_changes
tools.description: Read changes after a cursor; resynchronize on expired cursors rather than silently skipping events.

tools.name: ino_check_rules
tools.description: Run deterministic lexical rules. Results are distinct from native compile and cannot establish logic or runtime safety.
